items.question: Where did Brianna Turner play college basketball?
items.answer: Brianna Turner played at Notre Dame and was part of the team that won the 2018 NCAA championship. The Atlanta Dream drafted her 11th overall in 2019, and she began her WNBA career with the Phoenix Mercury.
